newsitem.title: USA: Telco Communications expects record Q4.
newsitem.headline: Telco Communications expects record Q4.

text.p: Telco Communications Group Inc said Friday it expects to report record net income and higher earnings per share than analysts' expectations for the fourth quarter of 1996.

The company also said that it wholly owned dial around subsidiaries (Dial & Save and Long Distance Wholesale Club) met management's expectations while its Commercial Sales Division exceeded expectations in terms of revenue growth, expenses within budgetary compliance and sales force expansion.
Additionally, its said it believes that the Commercial Sales Division will exceed previous expectations in overall contribution to the revenue and profitability for 1997 and 1998.
Telco said it plans on announcing its definitive fourth quarter earnings on or about February 11.
